disclaimer: Payroll figures are estimates: base salary and labor/health/pension use the full calendar month (mid-month joiners/leavers are not prorated); overtime pay and leave deductions use approved records within the pay period. Net pay only deducts labor/health/pension and excludes income tax and other deductions. Visible to HR and admin only.

snapshots.generateHint: Base salary and insurance use the data in effect on the last day of the month; overtime pay and leave deductions use approved records within the pay period (e.g. 9/26–10/25 for October). Drafts can be regenerated; locking freezes them.
snapshots.lockedCannotRegenerate: This month is locked. An admin must unlock it before it can be regenerated.

detail.title: {{month}} Details
detail.columnsHint: Gross pay = salary + overtime pay − leave deduction; Net pay = gross − employee insurance (incl. voluntary pension; excludes income tax and other deductions); Employer pays = labor + health + employer pension; Total employer cost = gross pay + employer pays.

confirm.lockBody: The figures will be frozen and unaffected by later rate or salary changes. Only an admin can unlock.
confirm.unlockBody: It returns to a draft and can be regenerated, replacing the frozen figures.
confirm.deleteBody: The draft will be deleted and can be generated again.
confirm.regenerateBody: The current draft will be replaced with figures from the latest salaries and rates.

rates.ratesHint: Paste CSV (columns: effectiveDate, key, value, note). No rates are built in; enter the officially announced values. If any row is invalid, nothing is imported.
rates.bracketsHint: Paste CSV (columns: effectiveDate, type, amount; type is labor, health or pension). A set for the same date and type is replaced as a whole. Used to check that insured salaries fall within a bracket.
rates.currentHint: Each month uses the latest settings effective on or before its first day.
rates.noRates: No rates imported yet. Import them before generating an estimate.

rateKeys.laborRate: Labor insurance rate (ordinary accident + employment insurance, %)
rateKeys.laborEmployerOnlyRate: Labor: employer-only rate (occupational accident, wage arrears fund etc., %; 0 if none)
rateKeys.healthAvgDependents: Health: average dependents (for employer share, announced by the government)

rules.settingsHint: Base salary and insurance use the full calendar month; only overtime and leave use the period from (cutoff + 1) of the previous month to the cutoff day of this month. Daily wage = monthly salary ÷ days per month; hourly wage = daily wage ÷ hours per day.
rules.periodExample: E.g. for October payroll, overtime and leave use 9/{{start}} ~ 10/{{end}}.
rules.overtimeHint: Only approved overtime paid as cash counts; overtime converted to comp time does not. Multiple entries on the same day are accumulated before applying tiers. Day type: not on a holiday = weekday; on a holiday with a holiday name in the calendar = national holiday; otherwise = rest day.
rules.noOvertimeRules: No overtime multipliers set yet. Set them before generating payroll.
rules.templateWarning: The template is only a prefill; verify it against company policy and current regulations. You can replace it entirely with CSV afterwards.
rules.csvHint: CSV columns: dayType (weekday / rest_day / holiday), fromHours, toHours (blank = no upper limit), multiplier. Each day type must start at 0 and be contiguous; if any row is invalid nothing is imported.
rules.leaveHint: 0 = no deduction, 0.5 = half pay, 1 = full deduction. A leave type used in the pay period without a ratio makes generation fail. Leave is attributed to the period containing its start date; leave spanning periods is counted entirely at its start.
rules.unsetWarning: {{count}} leave type(s) still have no deduction ratio.
rules.prefill: Prefill blanks from the paid/unpaid flag
